🚨 A whistleblower complaint is raising urgent new questions about mail-in voting ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

In this video, Chris Cillizza breaks down reports that the U.S. Postal Service may be moving ahead with a new “Federal Ballot Mail Portal” — a system intended to verify mail ballots that, according to the complaint, could create major problems if rushed into use. 📬🗳️

The whistleblower alleges that even a single barcode-scanning failure could potentially affect large batches of ballots, raising fears of delayed deliveries, rejected ballots, and widespread confusion just weeks before Election Day. ⚠️

Chris explains:

Why Donald Trump has spent years attacking mail-in voting and seeking a larger federal role in elections 🇺🇸

Why vote-by-mail has become a huge part of American elections — especially for older and rural voters 👵🌾

Why this issue could matter enormously in key battleground states like Arizona, Nevada, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Maine, and Florida 🗺️

Why Democrats may be especially vulnerable, given that their voters use mail ballots at higher rates 📊

What the courts — and potentially the Supreme Court ⚖️ — may decide before ballots begin going out

Whether this system can realistically be implemented in time for the 2026 midterms ⏳
